# SuprSend

> SuprSend is multi-channel notification infrastructure for product teams — workflows, templates, vendors, preferences, and a real-time in-app inbox, all behind one API. The fastest way to integrate is to connect SuprSend to your AI coding assistant via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and let it do the boilerplate.

This file is curated for AI agents. Pages are listed in the order an agent should consume them when implementing a SuprSend integration. The full doc index is at `/llms-full.txt`.

## Start here

- [Quickstart (the single end-to-end guide)](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/getting-started/quickstart.md): The canonical integration walkthrough — orient, set up the platform, install backend and frontend SDKs, build a workflow, trigger it (event vs API), wire preferences, ship to production. Read this first.
- [Mandatory concepts](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/getting-started/mandatory-concepts.md): Workflow, User, Template, Tenant, Preference — the five primitives every integration touches.
- [API keys and environments](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/getting-started/api-keys-and-environments.md): Workspace key, API Key, service token, Inbox secret — when to use which.

## Build with AI / MCP

- [MCP Overview](https://docs.suprsend.com/reference/mcp-overview.md): What the SuprSend MCP server exposes and how it connects to your AI client.
- [MCP Quickstart — Cursor](https://docs.suprsend.com/reference/mcp-quickstart-cursor.md): One-click install for Cursor.
- [MCP Quickstart — Claude](https://docs.suprsend.com/reference/mcp-quickstart-claude.md): Setup for Claude Desktop.
- [MCP Quickstart — Windsurf](https://docs.suprsend.com/reference/mcp-quickstart-windsurf.md): Setup for Windsurf.
- [MCP Tool List](https://docs.suprsend.com/reference/mcp-tool-list.md): Every tool the agent can call, organized by primitive.
- [Prompt Cheatsheet](https://docs.suprsend.com/reference/mcp-prompts.md): Copy-paste prompts for workflows, users, tenants, debugging, migration.
- [Agent Skills](https://docs.suprsend.com/reference/agent-skills.md): Markdown knowledge packages that give your agent the actual SuprSend schemas and CLI flags.

## Core primitives (deep dives)

- [Workflows](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/workflows.md): The unit of automation. Trigger + logic + delivery nodes.
- [Users](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/users.md): Recipients identified by `distinct_id` with channel addresses.
- [Templates Overview](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/templates-overview.md): Per-channel message content with Handlebars variables.
- [Tenants](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/tenants.md): Per-organization scoping for B2B.
- [User Preferences](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/user-preferences.md): Per-user opt-in/out at category, channel, or workflow level.
- [Notification Categories](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/notification-category.md): Group workflows so users can opt out by category.
- [Tenant Preferences](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/tenant-preference.md): Per-org overrides on top of categories.
- [Preference Evaluation](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/preference-evaluation.md): How preferences are resolved at send time.

## Triggering — event vs API

- [Event vs Workflow API decision guide](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/event-vs-workflow-api.md): Critical decision. Read before integrating.
- [Trigger Workflow guide](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/trigger-workflow.md): Every way to trigger a workflow — direct API, event-based, broadcast.
- [Events guide](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/events.md): How event-based triggers work end-to-end.
- [Trigger Workflow API reference](https://docs.suprsend.com/reference/trigger-workflow-api.md): The HTTP endpoint.
- [Trigger Event API reference](https://docs.suprsend.com/reference/trigger-event.md): The HTTP endpoint.

## Channel-specific guides

- [Email](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/email-quick-start.md): Vendor, identity, template, deliverability gotchas.

- [WhatsApp](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/whatsapp-quick-start.md): Vendor, identity, Meta template approval workflow.
- [Mobile Push](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/mobile-push-quick-start.md): FCM/APNs, mobile SDK identify call, template.
- [Web Push](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/web-push-quick-start.md): JS SDK, browser subscription, template.
- [Slack](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/slack-quick-start.md): Slack App, OAuth, per-tenant config.
- [MS Teams](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/ms-teams-quick-start.md): Teams App, Adaptive Cards.
- [Inbox channel](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/inbox-quick-start.md): Channel-specific notes.

## Multi-channel patterns

- [Multi-channel delivery](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/delivery-multi-channel.md): Parallel fanout to multiple channels.
- [Smart channel routing](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/smart-delivery.md): Sequential, stop on engagement.
- [Vendor fallback](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/vendor-fallback.md): Auto-failover within a channel.
- [Per-tenant vendors](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/tenant-vendor.md): Customer-specific vendor credentials in B2B.

- [Migrating Existing Notifications](https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/migrating-your-existing-notifications.md): Plan a migration from your current notification system.

- [Create or Update User](https://docs.suprsend.com/reference/create-update-users.md): User identification.
- [Postman Collection](https://docs.suprsend.com/reference/postman-collection.md): Test the entire API without writing code.
